I should not be running around looking for toys for tots or hardware for some guy... This is WOLFENSTEIN. - Way to much health and armor. title: world of guns: gun disassembly
text: This program is actually amazing. It's everything I would have dreamed of in a simulator like this. If you have any interest in guns this is a must-own, and best of all, it's 95% free. The fastest way to earn free XP for unlocks is to get good at the quiz, once an hour you can play to identify guns by their silhouette. If you get good at it you should be able to earn 4000+ XP every hour, so I was able to unlock most of the tree in a couple days. There are a few guns in the game you have to pay cash to unlock. This includes the M134 and the M2 which were the two I was most interested in for a program like this. However, the amount of work and detail put into the models and their function is completely over the top. I paid $6 to unlock those two and I feel it was actually worth it to support the makers of WOG. I enjoy the feeling of learning how to take apart some of the finest guns ever made and then getting to watch them operate in super slow-mo, X-rays, cutaways, it's perfect. There isn't much more I could ask out of a free program.
